title: Scalar Surface Integral over a Hemisphere
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate iint_S z d sigma over the upper hemisphere x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = 4 (z >= 0).

steps.title: Express d sigma for Sphere
steps.mathExpression: z = \sqrt{4 - x^2 - y^2} \implies d\sigma = \frac{a}{z} \, dA = \frac{2}{z} \, dA
steps.explanation: On a sphere of radius a = 2, the area element satisfies d sigma = (2/z) dA.
steps.why: Finding surface area metric for spherical cap.

steps.title: Simplify Integrand
steps.explanation: The variable height z cancels exactly with the denominator.

steps.title: Integrate Over Base Disk
steps.explanation: Multiply 2 by area of base circular disk 4*pi.
